description: OpenDRIVE road network dataset of Schwarzer Berg in Brunswick OpenDRIVE-Straßendatensatz vom Schwarzen Berg in Braunschweig is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Michael Scholz, Oliver Böttcher (Deutsches Zentrum für Luft- und Raumfahrt e. V. (DLR)). This lane-detailed HD map as OpenDRIVE dataset models road network parts of the "Schwarzer Berg" region in the city of Brunswick, Lower Saxony, Germany. Coverage: national (DE); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
